extras: Requires SessionId and Keep-Alive cookie configuration.
intentEvidence: This repository contains an Obsidian plugin that allows users to automatically fetch and display statistics from the Project Euler website.
problem: Users need a way to track and visualize their Project Euler progress, achievements, and statistics directly within their Obsidian vault.
summary: Automatically fetches and displays statistics, profile information, and progress tracking from the Project Euler website within Obsidian.
